aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware that this approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.
